note: Parsed from the owner-provided SiteOne line-item CSV. One object per invoice; branch is carried per invoice from the 'clements_branch' column. Only lines with qty_shipped != 0 are included (pure backorders/cancels are omitted). subtotalShipped = sum(extPrice) of the included lines (reproduces the printed subtotal, which includes fuel-surcharge lines). The loader (scripts/load-purchase-invoices.ts) decides which lines post stock.
